meta.title: Salaar Cease Fire Part 1
meta.tagline: An unbreakable bond of friendship is tested in a brutal city of blood and betrayal.
description: Set in the dystopian, lawless city-state of Khansaar, a dangerous power struggle moves toward open war as rival factions plot to overthrow the reigning monarchy. Years after going into hiding to live a quiet, peaceful life with his mother, Deva is forced back into the violence he abandoned. When Aadhya, a young woman hunted by powerful operatives, seeks sanctuary in his town, her arrival sets off a chain of events that reunites Deva with his childhood friend, Varadha.

Facing a fierce fight against relentless enemies vying for control of Khansaar's throne, Varadha relies on Deva's extraordinary combat prowess to survive. Bound by a sacred promise made in their youth, Deva unleashes immense rage to protect his friend against overwhelming armies. As ancient loyalties unravel and brutal conflicts erupt across the city, their eternal bond faces its ultimate trial amidst conspiracy, betrayal, and relentless bloodshed.
